# Embedded Emissions: Cannot Compute

**Embedded emissions for this line cannot be calculated under the supplied ruleset.**

## Input check

| Required input | Declared value | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code in table | 7201 (Pig iron) | ✅ Present |
| (b) Country of production listed for that good | USA | ❌ **Not in table** |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | 1,200 t | ✅ Present |

## Missing input

- **Default SEE for CN 7201 with country of production USA.** The factor table lists CN 7201 only for Türkiye (1.85), China (1.66), and India (2.53). There is no entry for the United States.

The ruleset selects the SEE by CN code and country together. Values for other countries cannot stand in for the USA, and no average or proxy is permitted.

## To complete this line

Provide a default SEE (tCO2e/t) for CN 7201 / USA from an authoritative source added to the factor table. The calculation would then be:

> Embedded emissions = SEE(7201, USA) × 1,200 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
